dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to your thoughts...

dialogues.speaker: Navayi
dialogues.text: It's okay. Thoughts are supposed to be exchanged through communications, no?

dialogues.speaker: Navayi
dialogues.text: Thank you for talking to me.

dialogues.speaker: Navayi
dialogues.text: Let me see... I only have some food brought from the Court of Fontaine. If you don't mind, please accept it as a greeting gift.
